G2800.def:
κλάσις, -εως, ἡ
(κλάω), 
a breaking: Luc 24:35, Actes 2:42.†

G2801.def:
κλάσμα, -τος, τό
(κλάω), [in LXX for פַּת, פֶּלַח ;] 
a broken piece, fragment: Matthieu 14:20 15:37, Marc 6:43 8:8, 19-20, Luc 9:17, Jean 6:12-13 †

G2802.def:
Καῦδα (TR, mg., Κλαῦδα; Rec. Κλαύδή), ἡ, 
Cauda, Clauda, an island near Crete: Actes 27:16.†

G2804G.def:
Κλαύδιος, -ου, ὁ 
Claudius; 
__1. the Emperor: Actes 11:28 18:2. 
__2. A military tribune, C. Lysias: Actes 23:26.†

G2804H.def:
Κλαύδιος, -ου, ὁ 
Claudius; 
__1. the Emperor: Actes 11:28 18:2. 
__2. A military tribune, C. Lysias: Actes 23:26.†

G2805.def:
κλαυθμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κλαίω), [in LXX chiefly for בְּכִי ;] 
crying, weeping, Actes 20:37; κ. καὶ ὀδυρμός, Matthieu 2:18 (LXX); ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ βρυγμός, Matthieu 8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30, Luc 13:28.†

G2806.def:
κλάω 
[in LXX: Jérémie 16:7 (פַּרְנַךְ), al. ;] 
to break, break in pieces: of bread, Matthieu 14:19 15:36 26:26, Marc 8:6 14:22, Luc 22:19 24:30, Actes 2:46 20:7, 11 27:35, 1 Corinthiens 10:16 11:24; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), Marc 8:19 (cf. ἐκ-, κατα-κλάω).†

G2807.def:
κλείς, -δός Att.. accusative, κλεῖν, later -εῖδα, pl., κλεῖδες, -ας, contr., -εῖς, ἡ, 
[in LXX for מַפְתֵּחַ, Ésaïe 22:22, al. ;] 
a key. Fig., τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν, Matthieu 16:19; τ. γνώσεως, Luc 11:52; of David (cf. LXX, l.with), Apocalypse 3:7; τ. θανάτου κ. τ. ᾅδου, Apocalypse 1:18; τ. ἀβύσσαυ, Apocalypse 20:1; τ. φρέατος τῆς ἀ., Apocalypse 9:1.†

G2808.def:
κλείω 
[in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;] 
to shut: θύραν, Matthieu 6:6; τ. ἄβυσσον, Apocalypse 20:3; pass., θύρα, Matthieu 25:10, Luc 11:7 (pl.), Jean 20:19, 26, Actes 21:30; δεσμωτήριον, Actes 5:23; πυλῶνες, Apocalypse 21:25. Metaphorical, τ. οὐρανόν, Luc 4:25, Romains 11:6; τ. σπλάγχνα, 1 Jean 3:17; τ. βασιλείαν, Matthieu 23:14; id. absol., Apocalypse 3:7; τ. θύραν, Apocalypse 3:8. (cf. ἀπο-, ἐκ-, κατα-, συν-κλείω.) †

G2809.def:
κλέμμα, -τος, τό
(κλέπτω), [in LXX: Genèse 31:39, Exode 22:3-4 (2-3) (גָּנַב, גְּנֵבָה)* ;] 
__1. a thing stolen (Arist., LXX) 
__2. = κλοπή, theft (Plato, al.): pl., Apocalypse 9:21.†

G2811.def:
κλέος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX: Job 28:22 (שֵׁמַע) Job 30:8 * ;] 
__1. a rumour, report. 
__2. good report, fame, glory: 1 Pierre 2:20.†

G2812.def:
κλέπτης, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX for גַּנָּב ;] 
a thief: Matthieu 6:19-20 24:43, Luc 12:33, 39, Jean 10:1, 10 12:6, 1 Corinthiens 6:10, 1 Pierre 4:15. Fig., ὡς κ. ἐν νυκτί, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:2 5:4 (κλέπτας, WH, txt., R, mg.; see Lft., Notes, 73; but cf. also M, Th., l.with), 2 Pierre 3:10, Apocalypse 3:3 16:15. Metaphorical, of false teachers, Jean 10:8.†
SYN.: λῃστής, a robber, a brigand who plunders, openly, with violence; κ. is a thief who steals in secret, by fraud and cunning (Tr., Syn., § xliv)

G2813.def:
κλέπτω 
[in LXX for גָּנַב ;] 
to steal: absol., Matthieu 6:19-20 19:18, Marc 10:19, Luc 18:20, Jean 10:10, Romains 2:21 13:9, Éphésiens 4:28; with accusative, Matthieu 27:64 28:13.†

G2814.def:
κλῆμα, -τος, τό
(κλάω), [in LXX chiefly for זְמוֹרָה, דָּלִיָּה, Eze.15:2 17:6-7, al. ;] 
a vine-twig, vine-branch: Jean 15:2, 4-6.†

G2816.def:
κληρονομέω, -ῶ
(κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for יָרַשׁ, also for נָחַל, etc. ;] 
__1. to receive by lot. 
__2. to inherit (in cl., usually with genitive of thing(s)): absol., Galates 4:30 (LXX); in general, to possess oneself of, receive as one's own, obtain (as Deutéronome 4:5, al., cf. Psaumes 25:3, Ésaïe 61:7): with accusative of thing(s) (as generally in late Gk., see M, Pr., 65), of the Messianic Kingdom (cf. Psaumes 37:11, Sir.4:13 37:26, and see Dalman, Words, 125 ff.) and its bless­ings and privileges, τ. γῆν, Matthieu 5:5 (cf. LXX); τ. βασιλείαν, β. θεοῦ, Matthieu 25:34, 1 Corinthiens 6:9-10 15:50, Galates 5:21; ζωὴν αἰώνιον, Matthieu 19:29, Marc 10:17, Luc 10:25 18:18; σωτηρίαν, Hébreux 1:14; τ. ἐπαγγελίας, Hébreux 6:12; ἀφθαρσίαν, 1 Corinthiens 15:50; ὄνομα, Hébreux 1:4; τ. εὐλογίαν, Hébreux 12:17, 1 Pierre 3:9; ταῦτα, Apocalypse 21:7 (cf. κατα-κληρονομέω).†

G2817.def:
κληρονομία, -ας, ἡ
(κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for נַחֲלָה, also for יְרֻשָּׁה, etc. ;] 
prop., an inherited property, an inheritance: Matthieu 21:38, Marc 12:7, Luc 12:13 20:14; in general, a possession, inheritance: Actes 7:5, Hébreux 11:8; of the Messianic Kingdom and its blessings, Actes 20:32, Galates 3:18, Colossiens 3:24, Éphésiens 1:14, 18 5:5, Hébreux 9:15, 1 Pierre 1:4.†

G2818.def:
κληρο-νόμος, -ου, ὁ
(κλῆρος, νέμομαι, to possess) [in LXX: Juges 18:7, 2 Rois 14:7, Michée 1:15, Jérémie 8:10 (יָרַשׁ), Sir.23:22 * ;] 
__1. (as in cl.) an heir: Matthieu 21:38, Marc 12:7, Luc 20:14, Galates 4:1; of those who as sons of God inherit the privileges of the Messianic Kingdom; of Christ himself, Hébreux 1:2; of Abraham, Romains 4:13-14; of Christians, Romains 8:17, Galates 3:29, Tite 3:7, Jacques 2:5. 
__2. (As in LXX: Jg, Mi, Je, ll. with) a possessor: Hébreux 6:17 11:7 (Cremer, 359 f.).†

G2820.def:
κληρόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 1 Rois 14:41 (לָכַד ni.), Esther 4:11 A (קָרָא ni.), Ésaïe 17:11 * ;] 
__1. to cast lots. 
__2. to choose by lot. 
__3. to assign by lot, assign a portion: pass., ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν, Éphésiens 1:11 (on the various interpretations, see ICC; AR; Ellic., in l).†

G2821.def:
κλῆσις, -εως, ἡ (καλέω) 
[in LXX: Jérémie 31:6 (קָרָא), Jdth.12:10 A, 3Ma.5:14 * ;] 
a calling, call; in NT, always of the Divine call to salvation: Romains 11:29, 1 Corinthiens 1:26 7:20, Éphésiens 1:18 4:1, 4, Philippiens 3:14, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:11, 2 Timothée 1:9, Hébreux 3:1, 2 Pierre 1:10 (Cremer, 332).†

G2823.def:
κλίβανος, -ον, ό
(Att.., κρίβ-, but κλ- in Ion., Hdt., ii, 92), [in LXX for תַּנּוּר, Genèse 15:17, Osée 7:4, 6 al. ;] 
__1. in cl., a clibanus, cribanus, an earthen vessel for baking bread. 
__2. In LXX and NT, a furnace (cf. MM, Exp., xv), an oven: Matthieu 6:30, Luc 12:28.†

G2824.def:
κλίμα, -τος, τό
(κλίνω) [in LXX: Juges 20:2 A (פִּנָּה)* ;] 
__1. an inclination, slope, esp. the slope from the equator to the pole (Arist). 
__2. a region (Polyb., al.): pl., Romains 15:23, 2 Corinthiens 11:10, Galates 1:21.†

G2825.def:
κλίνη, -ης, ἡ
(κλίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִטָּה ;] 
a bed, couch: Matthieu 9:2, 6, Marc 4:21 7:4, 30, Luc 5:18 8:16 17:34, Apocalypse 2:22 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).†

G2826.def:
κλινίδιον, -ου, τό 
dimin. of κλίνη, 
a conch: Luc 5:19, 24 (cf. κλενάριον).†

G2827.def:
κλίνω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָטָה ;] 
__1. to make to bend, to bow: τ. κεφαλήν (of one dying), Jean 19:30; τ. πρόσωτον (of terrified persons), Luc 24:5. 
__2. to make to lean, to rest: τ. κεφαλήν (in sleep), Matthieu 8:20, Luc 9:58. 
__3. As in Hom., of soldiers, to turn (to flight), παρεμβολάς, Hébreux 11:34. 
__4. In late Gk. (as mid, in cl.), to decline: intrans., ἡ ἡμέρα, Luc 9:12 24:29.†

G2828.def:
κλισία, -ας, ή
(κλίνω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6:31 A* ;] 
__1. a place for reclining; hence, 
__(a) a hut; 
__(b) an easy chair; 
__(with) a couch. 
__2. a company reclining: pl., Luc 9:14 (cf. FlJ, Ant., xii, 2, 12)

G2829.def:
κλοπή, -ῆν, ἡ
(κλέπτω), [in LXX for גָּנַב ;] 
theft: pl., Matthieu 15:19, Marc 7:22.†

G2830.def:
κλύδων, -ωνος, ὁ
(κλύζω, of the sea, to wash over), [in LXX: Jonas 1:4; Jonas 1:12 (סַעַר), al. ;] 
a billow, surge: Luc 8:24, Jacques 1:6.†
SYN.: κῦμα, a wave

G2831.def:
κλυδωνίζομαι
(κλύδων), [in LXX: Ésaïe 57:20 (גָּרַשׁ)* ;] 
to be tossed by waves; metaphorically, to be tossed like waves (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 11, 3): Éphésiens 4:14.†

G2832.def:
Κλωπᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram.; on the original, see Lft., Gal., 267 f.), 
Clopas: Jean 19:25.†

G2833.def:
κνήθω
(late form of κνάω), 
__1. to scratch. 
__2. to tickle; pass., to itch: 2 Timothée 4:3.†

G2834.def:
Κνίδος, -ου, ἡ 
Cnidus, a city (and peninsula) on S.W. coast of Asia Minor: Actes 27:7.†

G2835.def:
κοδράντης, -ου, ὁ (Lat. quadrans, the fourth part of an as), 
a quadrans (AV, farthing): Matthieu 5:26, Marc 12:42.†

G2836.def:
κοιλία, -ας, ἡ
(κοῖλος, hollow), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּטֶן, מֵעֶה, קֶרֶב, Deutéronome 7:13, 2 Rois 7:12, Genèse 41:21, al.; also (Job 3:11 10:18 31:15 38:8) for רֶחֶם ;] 
__1. the belly (stomach or intestines or both): Matthieu 12:40 15:17, Marc 7:19, Luc 15:16, Romains 16:18, 1 Corinthiens 6:13, Philippiens 3:19, Apocalypse 10:9-10. 
__2. (As often in LXX) the womb: Luc 1:41-42, 44 2:21 11:27 23:29, Jean 3:4; ἐκ κ. μητρός (cf. Psaumes 22:11, Job 1:21, al.), Matthieu 19:12, Luc 1:15, Actes 3:2 14:8, Galates 1:15. 
__3. Metaphorical (as Heb. בֶּטֶן, cf. Job 15:35, Proverbes 20:27, Sir.19:12), of the heart: Jean 7:38.†

G2837.def:
κοιμάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַב ;] 
to lull to sleep, put to sleep. Mid and pass., to fall asleep (M, Pr., 162; M, Th., 1, 4, 13): Matthieu 28:13, Luc 22:45, Jean 11:12, Actes 12:6. Metaph, of death: Matthieu 27:52, Jean 11:11 Actes 7:60 13:36, 1 Corinthiens 7:39 11:30 15:6 15:18 15:20 15:51, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:13-15, 2 Pierre 3:4 (cf. Ésaïe 14:8 43:17, 2Ma.12:45).†
SYN.: καθεύδω

G2838.def:
κοίμησις, -εως, ἡ 
[in LXX: Sir.46:19 48:13 * ;] 
a reclining, resting: Jean 11:13.†

G2839G.def:
κοινός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX: Proverbes 1:14 (אֶחָד) Proverbes 21:9 25:24 (חֶבֶר), Wis.7:3, al. ;] 
__1. common (general; = Lat. communis): Actes 2:44 4:32; κ. πίστις, Tite 1:4; σωτηρία, Ju 3 
__2. common (ordinary; = vulgaris); hence in LXX (1Ma.1:47, al.) and NT, unhallowed, unclean (cl., βέβηλος, which see): Marc 7:2, 5, Actes 10:14, 28 11:8, Romains 14:14, Hébreux 10:29, Apocalypse 21:27.†

G2839H.def:
κοινός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX: Proverbes 1:14 (אֶחָד) Proverbes 21:9 25:24 (חֶבֶר), Wis.7:3, al. ;] 
__1. common (general; = Lat. communis): Actes 2:44 4:32; κ. πίστις, Tite 1:4; σωτηρία, Ju 3 
__2. common (ordinary; = vulgaris); hence in LXX (1Ma.1:47, al.) and NT, unhallowed, unclean (cl., βέβηλος, which see): Marc 7:2, 5, Actes 10:14, 28 11:8, Romains 14:14, Hébreux 10:29, Apocalypse 21:27.†

G2840.def:
κοινόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 4Ma.7:6 א R* ;] 
__1. in cl., to make common. 
__2. In LXX, l.with, and NT (as κοινός, 2), to make ceremonially unclean, to profane (= cl., βεληλόω): Matthieu 15:11, 18 15:20, Marc 7:15, 18 7:20, 23, Actes 21:28; pass., Hébreux 9:13. 
__3. to count unclean (cf. δικαιόω): Actes 10:15 11:9.†
SYN.: βεβηλόω. Thayer (see word κ.) mentions that Winer Notes the accuracy whereby the Jews are said to use κ. in addressing Jews, Actes 21:28, and β. when speaking to Felix, 24:6 (Cremer, 362)

G2841.def:
κοινωνέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 2 Chroniques 20:35, Job 34:8, Ecclésiaste 9:4 (חָבַר), Proverbes 1:11, Wis.6:23, Sir.13:1, al. ;] 
to have a share of, go shares in (something) with (some one), take part in: with genitive of thing(s) (as usually in cl., so Pr, l.with), Hébreux 2:14; with dative of thing(s), Romains 12:13 15:27, 1 Timothée 5:22, 1 Pierre 4:13, 2Jn.11; with dative of person(s), before εἰς, Philippiens 4:15; ἐν, Galates 6:6 (cf. συν-κοινωνέω).†

G2842.def:
κοινωνία, -ας, ἡ
(κοινωνός), [in LXX: Lévitique 6:2 (יָד תְּשׂוּמֶת), Wis.8:18, 3Ma.4:6 * ;] 
__1. fellowship, communion: Actes 2:42, 2 Corinthiens 6:14, Philippiens 1:5; τ. υἱοῦ, 1 Corinthiens 1:9; τ. αἵματος, σώματος Χρ., 1 Corinthiens 10:10 : παθημάτων αὐτσῦ, Philippiens 3:10; τ. πνεύματος, 2 Corinthiens 13:13, Philippiens 2:1; δεξιὰς κοινωνίας, Galates 2:9; τ. πίστεώς σου, Phm 6; before μετὰ: τ. πατρός, 1 Jean 1:3 Jn 1:6; ἡμῶν, ἀλλήλων, 1 Jean 1:3 Jn 1:7. 
__2. contribution (as outcome of fellowship): Romains 15:26, 2 Corinthiens 8:4 9:13, Hébreux 13:6 (cf. Art. Communion, DB, i, 460 ff.; MM, Exp., xv).†

G2843.def:
κοινωνικός, -ή, -όν
(κοινωνία), 
__1. sociable. 
__2. ready to com­municate or impart (R, mg., ready to sympathize, see Field, Notes, 213 f.): 1 Timothée 6:18.†

G2844.def:
κοινωνός, -ή, -όν
(κοινός), [in LXX: Proverbes 28:24, Ésaïe 1:23 (חָבֵר), Malachie 2:14 (חֲבֶרֶת), Esther 8:13, al. ;] 
__1. as adj., = κοινός. 
__2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ κ., 
__(a) a partner, associate, companion: 2 Corinthiens 8:23, Phm 17; with dative of person(s), Luc 5:10; with genitive of person(s), Hébreux 10:33; id. before ἐν, Matthieu 23:30; 
__(b) a partaker, sharer: with genitive of thing(s), 1 Corinthiens 10:18 10:20, 2 Corinthiens 1:7, 1 Pierre 5:1, 2 Pierre 1:4 (see Deiss., BS, 368 n2).†

G2845.def:
κοίτη, -ης, ἡ (in Hom., κοῖτος) 
[in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁכָּב, also for שְׁכָבָה, etc. ;] 
a bed: Luc 11:7; esp. the marriage-bed: κ. ἀμίαντος, Hébreux 13:4; κ. ἔχειν, of a woman conceiving, Romains 9:10 (cf. peculiar phrases in LXX, Lévitique 15:18, al.); of illicit intercourse, pl., Romains 13:13.†

G2846.def:
κοιτών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(κοίτη = Att.., δωμότιον, see Kennedy, Sources, 40), [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר, 2 Rois 4:7, Joël 2:16; I Esther 3:3, al. ;] 
a bed-chamber; ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ κ., a chamberlain: Actes 12:20.†

G2847.def:
κόκκινος, -η, -ον
(κόκκος, as used of the "berry" of the ilex coccifera, see DB, iv, 416), [in LXX for תּוֹלָע, תּוֹלָע, שָׁנִי, Exode 25:4, Genèse 38:23, Ésaïe 1:18, al. ;] 
scarlet: Matthieu 27:28, Hébreux 9:19, Apocalypse 17:3; neut., without substantive, of clothing, Apocalypse 17:4 18:12, 16,†

G2848.def:
κόκκος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: La 4:5 B א R (תּוֹלָע), Sir.45:11 * ;] 
a grain: Matthieu 13:31 17:20, Marc 4:31, Luc 13:19 17:6, Jean 12:24, 1 Corinthiens 15:37.†

G2849.def:
κολάζω
(κόλος, docked), [in LXX: Daniel 6:12 (13) (no Heb.), I Esther 8:24, Wis.3:4 (and freq.), 1Ma.7:7, al. ;] 
__1. to curtail, dock, prune. 
__2. to check, restrain. 
__3. to chastise, correct, punish: pass., 2 Pierre 2:9; mid., cause to be punished (3Ma.7:3): Actes 4:21.†

G2850.def:
κολακία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ 
(κολακεύω, to flatter), 
flattery: 1 Thessaloniciens 2:5 (see Lft., Notes, 23).†

G2851.def:
κόλασις, -εως, ἡ
(κολάζω), [in LXX: Eze.14:3-7 18:30 44:12, (מִכְשׁוֹל) Eze.43:11, λαμβάνειν τὴν κ. (כָּלַם ni.); Wis.11:13 16:2, 24 19:4, Jérémie 18:20, 2-4 Mac.5 * ;] 
correction, penalty, punishment: Matthieu 25:46, 1 Jean 4:18.†
SYN.: τιμωρία, requital. Arist. distinguishes between κ . as that which, being disciplinary, has reference to the sufferer, and τ. as that which, being penal, has reference to the satisfaction of him who inflicts (see Thayer, see word κ., and cf. Tr., Syn., § vii). But in late Gk. especially, the distinction is not always maintained (see reff. in Thayer)

G2852.def:
κολαφίζω
(κόλαφος = Att.., κόνδυλοι, the knuckles, the closed fist) 
to strike with the fist, to buffet: Matthieu 26:67, Marc 14:65, 2 Corinthiens 12:7; pass., 1 Corinthiens 4:11, 1 Pierre 2:20.†

G2853.def:
κολλάω, -ῶ
(κόλλα, glue), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;] 
__1. to glue or cement together. 
__2. Generally, to unite, to join firmly. Pass., to cleave to, join (oneself to): with dative of person(s), Matthieu 19:5(LXX), Luc 10:11 15:15, Actes 5:13 (but see Field, Notes, 118) Actes 9:26 10:28 (see Field, l.with) Actes 17:34; τ. πόρνῃ, 1 Corinthiens 6:16; τ. Κυρίῳ, 1 Corinthiens 6:17; with dative of thing(s), ἅρματι, Actes 8:29; τ. ἀγαθῴ, Romains 12:9; of sins joining together, ἄχρι τ. οὐρανοῦ, Apocalypse 18:5, of dust, Luc 10:11 (cf. τροσ-κολλάω).†

G2854.def:
κολλούριον
(TTr., κολλύ-, the more usual form), -ου, τό (dimin. of κολλύρα = κόλλιξ, a coarse bread roll), [in LXX: 3Ki.12:24 hil B* ;] 
__1. a small bread roll (LXX, ll. with). 
__2. (Usually in pl., LS, see word) an eye salve shaped like a roll: Apocalypse 3:18.†

G2855.def:
κολλυβιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόλλυβος, a small coin, a rate of exchange), 
a money-changer: Matthieu 21:12, Marc 11:15, Jean 2:15 (of. κερματιοτής).†

G2856.def:
κολοβόω, -ῶ
(κολοβός, docked), [in LXX: 2 Rois 4:12 (קָצַץ pi.) * ;] 
to cut off, amputate (LXX), hence, to curtail, shorten: Matthieu 24:22, Marc 13:20.†

G2857G.def:
Κολοσσαί
(so in cl.; -ασσαί, Rec., LTr.), -ῶν, αἰ 
Colossæ, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: Colossiens 1:2.†

G2858.def:
Κολασσαεύς (Rec. Κολοσ-), -έως, ὁ 
a Colossian: pl., Col., tit. (and subscr., Rec., Tr.).†

G2859.def:
κόλπος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for חֵיק ;] 
__1. prop., the bosom: Jean 13:23; fig., of close association, ἐν (εἰς τὸν) τοῖς κ. Ἀβραάμ, Luc 16:22-23 (cf. 4Ma.13:16); ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κ. τ. πατρός, Jean 1:18 
__2. The bosom or fold of a loose garment falling over a girdle, used as a pocket, hence figuratively, εἰς τὸν κ. Ésaïe 65:6, Jérémie 32:18 : Luc 6:38 
__3. A bosom-like hollow, as a bay or gulf: Actes 27:39.†

G2860.def:
κολυμβάω, -ῶ 
[in AI.: Ésaïe 25:11 * ;] 
to dive, plunge into the sea: Actes 27:43 (cf. ἐκ-κολνμβάω).†

G2861.def:
κολυμβήθρα, -ας, ἡ
(κολνμβάω), [in LXX for בְּרֵכָה, 4Ki.18:27, al. ;] 
a swimming pool, pool: Jean 5:2, 4 5:7 9:7.†

G2862.def:
κολωνία (Rec. -ώνια), -ας, ἡ 
(Lat. colonic), 
a colony: Actes 16:12 (see Lft., Phi., 50 f.).†

G2863.def:
κομάω, -ῶ
(κόμη), 
to wear long hair: 1 Corinthiens 11:14-15.†

G2864.def:
κόμη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX: Nombres 6:5, Eze.44:20 (פֶּרַע), al. ;] 
the hair: 1 Corinthiens 11:15.†

G2865.def:
κομίζω 
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;] 
__1. to take care of. 
__2. to carry off safe. 
__3. to carry off as booty. 
__4. to bear or carry: Luc 7:37. Mid., to bear for oneself, hence, 
__(a) to receive: Hébreux 10:36 11:13, 39, 1 Pierre 1:9 5:4, 2 Pierre 2:13; 
__(b) to receive back, recover (in cl. so also act.): Matthieu 25:27, Hébreux 11:19; metaphorically, of requital, 2 Corinthiens 5:10, Colossiens 3:25; παρὰ Κυρίου, Éphésiens 6:8 (cf. ἐκ-, συν-κομίζω).†

G2866.def:
κομψός, -ή, -όν
(κομέω, to take care of), 
well-dressed, elegant, fine; compar. neut., κομψότερον ἔχειν (cf. κόμψως ἔχειν, Epict., and colloq. Eng., "to be doing finely"): Jean 4:52.†

G2867.def:
κονιάω, -ῶ
(κονία, dust, lime), [in LXX: Deutéronome 27:2, 4 (שִׂיד), Proverbes 21:9 * ;] 
to plaster or whiten over: of tombs, Matthieu 23:27; figuratively, of a hypocrite, Actes 23:3.†

G2868.def:
κονιορτός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόνις or κονία, dust, ὄρνυμι, to stir up), [in LXX for אָבָק, etc. ;] 
in cl., dust stirred up (Exode 9:9, Ésaïe 5:24); in NT, simply dust: Matthieu 10:14, Luc 9:5 10:11, Actes 13:51 22:23.†

G2869.def:
κοπάζω
(κόπος), [in LXX: Genèse 8:1, Esther 2:1 7:10 (שָׁכַךְ), Ruth 1:18, al. (חָדַל), חָדַל), Jonas 1:11-12 (שָׁתַק), al. ;] 
to grow weary; of the wind (Hdt., Jh., l.with), to abate, cease raging: Matthieu 14:32, Marc 4:39 6:51.†

G2870.def:
κοπετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόπτω, mid.), [in LXX chiefly for מִסְפֵּד ;] 
= cl. κομμός, a beating of the head and breast, lamentation: before ἐπί with dative of person(s), Actes 8:2.†

G2871.def:
κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(κόπτω), [in LXX: Genèse 14:17, Josué 10:20 (נָכָה hi., מַכָּה), Deutéronome 28:25 (נָגַף), Jdth.15:7 * ;] 
__1. in cl., a stroke, a pounding (as in a mortar). 
__2. In LXX, a smiting in battle: Hébreux 7:1 (LXX).†

G2872.def:
κοπιάω, -ῶ
(κόπος), [in LXX chiefly for יָגַע ;] 
__1. (as in cl.) to grow weary: Matthieu 11:28, Jean 4:6, Apocalypse 2:3 (cf. Ésaïe 40:31). 
__2. Hence, in LXX and NT, to work with effort, to toil: absol., Matthieu 6:23, Luc 5:5 12:27, Jean 4:38, Actes 20:35, 1 Corinthiens 4:12, Éphésiens 4:28, 2 Timothée 2:5; with accusative of thing(s), Jean 4:38; frequently in Paul. Epp., of ministerial labour: 1 Corinthiens 15:10 16:16; before ἐν, Romains 16:12, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:12 (see M, Th., in l), 1 Timothée 5:17; εἰς, Romains 16:6, Galates 4:11, Philippiens 2:16, Colossiens 1:29, 1 Timothée 4:10.†

G2873.def:
κόπος, -ου, ὁ
(κόπτω) [in LXX chiefly for עָמָל, also for אָוֶן, etc. ;] 
__1. a striking, beating (in Jérémie 45:3 = κοπετός) 
__2. laborious toil, trouble: Jean 4:38, 1 Corinthiens 3:8 15:58, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:5; κ. τ. ἀγάπης, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:3; ἔργα καὶ κ., Apocalypse 2:2; κ. καὶ μόχθος, 2 Corinthiens 11:27, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:9, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:8; pl., ἐν κ., 2 Corinthiens 6:5 10:15 11:23; ἐκ τ. κ., Apocalypse 14:13; κόπονς (-ον) παρέχειν (in cl. more frequently π. πράγματα, πονον), with dative of person(s), Matthieu 26:10, Marc 14:6, Luc 11:7 18:5, Galates 6:17.†
SYN.: μόλθος, labour; πόνος (which see), toil, painful effort; in cl., "π. gives prominence to the effort (work as requiring force), κ. to the fatigue, μ. (chiefly poetic) to the hardship" (Thayer, see word κ.)

G2874.def:
κοπρία, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for אַשְׁפֹּת ;] 
a dung hill (1 Rois 2:8, Psaumes 113:7 al.): Luc 14:35.†
κόπριον, -ου, τό, 
[in LXX (pl.): Jérémie 25:33 (דֹּמֶן), Sir.22:2, 1Ma.2:62 * ;] 
= κόπρος, dung: pl., Luc 13:8 (WH, mg., κόφινον κοπρίων).†

G2875.def:
κόπτω 
[in LXX for כָּרַת, סָפַד, נָכָה hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to strike, smite. 
__2. to cut off: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Matthieu 21:8; ἐκ, Marc 11:8. Mid., to beat one's breast with grief, to mourn, bewail: Matthieu 11:17 24:30; with accusative of person(s), Luc 8:52 23:27; before ἐπί, with accusative, Apocalypse 1:7 18:9 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐν-, κατα-, προ-, προσ-κόπτω).†
SYN.: θρηνέω, q.v

G2876.def:
κόραξ, -ακος, ὁ 
[in LXX for עֹרֵב ;] 
a raven: Luc 12:24.†

G2877.def:
κοράσιον, -ου, τό 
(dimin. of κόρη), [in LXX chiefly for נַעֲרָה, Ruth 2:8, al.; in Joel 4:3, Zacharie 8:5 for יַלְדָּה ;] 
a colloquial word which survives in MGr. (Kennedy, Sourcs, e154), girl, maiden: Matthieu 9:24-25 14:11, Marc 5:41-42 6:22, 28.†

G2878.def:
κορβάν (Rec., T, -βᾶν), indecl. (Heb. קׇרְבָּן), 
an offering, a gift offered to God: Marc 7:11 (cf. κορβανᾶς).†

G2879.def:
Κορέ indecl. 
(in FlJ, -έου), ὁ (Heb. קֶרַח) 
Korah: Ju 11.†

G2880.def:
κορέννυμι
(κόρος, surfeit), [in Symmachus.: Psaumes 22:27, Al, Psaumes 103:5 * ;] 
to satisfy: pass., τροφῆς, Actes 27:38; metaphorically, of spiritual things, 1 Corinthiens 4:8.†

G2881.def:
κορίνθιος, -α, -ον 
Corinthian; as subst., ὁ Κ., a Corinthian: Actes 18:8 27:1-44 (WH, txt., R, omit), 2 Corinthiens 6:11; 1Co, 2Co, tit.†

G2882.def:
Κόρινθος, -ου, ἡ 
Corinth: Actes 18:1, 27 19:1, 1 Corinthiens 1:2, 2 Corinthiens 1:1 1:23, 2 Timothée 4:20.†

G2884.def:
κόρος, -ου, ὁ
(Heb. כֹּר), [in LXX: Lévitique 27:16, Nombres 11:32, Eze.45:13 (חֹמֶר); more freq., 2 Chroniques 27:5, al.(כֹּר) ;] 
a cor, a Hebrew measure (AV, RV, measure): Luc 16:7.†

G2885.def:
κοσμέω, -ῶ
(κόσμος), [in LXX for עָדָה, תָּקַן, etc. ;] 
__1. to order, arrange, prepare (in Hom. esp. of marshalling armies): Matthieu 25:7 (cf. Sir.50:9, al.). 
__2. to adorn, furnish: οἶκον, pass., Matthieu 12:44, Luc 11:25; μνημεῖα, Matthieu 23:29; τὸ ἱερόν, pass., Luc 21:5; θεμέλιοι, Apocalypse 21:19; νύμφην, pass., Apocalypse 21:2; ἐαυτάς, before ἐν, 1 Timothée 2:9. Metaphorical, with accusative of person(s), 1 Pierre 3:5; with accusative of thing(s), Tite 2:10.†

G2886.def:
κοσμικός, -ή, -όν
(κόσμος) 
__1. pertaining to the world or universe. 
__2. of this world, earthly. Hébreux 9:1. 
__3. In ethical sense, worldly: ἐπιθυμίαι, Tite 2:12.†

G2887.def:
κόσμιος, -ον (in cl. -α, -ον), 
(κόσμος), [in LXX: Ecclésiaste 12:9 (תָּקַן)* ;] 
orderly, decent, modest: 1 Timothée 2:9 (WH, mg., -ίως, which see) 1 Timothée 3:2.†

G2888.def:
κοσμοκράτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
(κόσμος, κρατέω), 
__1. in Orphic hymns, al. (see AR, Eph., l.with), a ruler of the whole world (and so in Rabbinic writings: קוֺזמוֺקְרָטוֺר). 
__2. a ruler of this world (in contrast to παντο κράτωρ): οἱ κ. τ. σκότους τούτου, the rulers of this dark world, Éphésiens 6:12.†

G2889.def:
κόσμος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Genèse 2:1, Deutéronome 4:19 17:3, Ésaïe 24:21 40:26 (צבא), Exode 33:5, 6 Jérémie 2:32 4:30, Eze.7:20 16:11 23:40 (עֲדִי), Ésaïe 61:10 (כְּלִי), al., Wis.2:24 and freq., Sir.6:30, al ;] 
__1. order (Hom., Plat., al.). 
__2. ornament, adornment, esp. of women (Hom., al.): 1 Pierre 3:3. 
__3. Later, the world or universe, as an ordered system (Plat., al.): Actes 17:24, Romains 4:13, 1 Corinthiens 3:22, Philippiens 2:15, Hébreux 4:3, al. 
__4. In late writers only, the world, i.e. the earth (= ἡ οἰκουμένη, cf. Matthieu 4:8 with Luc 4:5): Matthieu 4:8, Mrk.16:[15], Colossiens 2:20, 1 Timothée 6:7, al.; hence by meton., 
__(a) of the human inhabitants of the world: Matthieu 5:14 15:38, Marc 14:9, Jean 1:10 4:42 12:47, Romains 3:6, 1 Corinthiens 4:13, 2 Corinthiens 5:19, 2 Pierre 2:5, al.; 
__(b) of worldly affairs or possessions: Matthieu 16:26, Marc 8:36, Luc 9:25, 1 Corinthiens 7:31, 1 Jean 2:16, al.; 
__(with) in ethical sense, of the ungodly: Jean 7:7 14:17, 27 1 Corinthiens 1:21, Jacques 1:27, 1 Jean 4:4, al.; 
__(d) metaphorically: ὁ κ. τῆς ἀδικίας, Jacques 3:6. 
SYN.: αἰών, which see (cf . also Dalman, Words, 162ff.; Tr., Syn., §lix; Westc., additional note on Jean 1:10; DB, iv, 938ff.).

G2891.def:
κούμ (Tr., txt., κοῦμ, Rec. κοῦμι) (Heb. imperat. masc., used as an interjection, קוּם), 
koum (arise): Marc 5:41.†

G2892.def:
κουστωδία, -ας, ἡ (Lat. custodia), 
a guard: Matthieu 27:65-66 28:11.†

G2893.def:
κουφίζω
(κοῦφος, light), [in LXX: Exode 18:22, Jonas 1:5, al. (קָלַל hi.), Esther 5:1, al. ;] 
__1. intrans., to be light (poetic chiefly). 
__2. to lighten, make light: with accusative, Actes 27:38.†

G2894.def:
κόφινος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Juges 6:19 (סַל), Psaumes 81:6 (דּוּד)* ;] 
a basket, probably of wicker-work, such as were carried by Jews for food: Matthieu 14:20 16:9, Marc 6:43 8:19 9:17 13:8, Jean 6:13 (cf. σφυρίς).†

G2895.def:
κράβαττος (Rec. κράββατος), ου, ὁ 
(a Macedonian word, = Lat. grabatus, cl. σκίμπους), [in Aquila.: Amos 3:12 * ;] 
a camp bed, pallet: Marc 2:4, 9 2:11-12 6:55, Jean 5:8-11, Actes 5:15 9:33 (see Swete, Mk., 24, and cf. κλίνη).†

G2896.def:
κράζω 
[in LXX for זָעַק, צָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;] 
in cl. chiefly poët., 
__1. prop. onomatop., of the raven, to croak, hence generally, of inartic. cries, to scream, cry out (Æsch., al.): Marc 5:5 9:26 15:39 (Rec., R, mg.), Luc 9:39, al.; of crying for vengeance (cf. Genèse 4:10), Jacques 5:4. 
__2. to cry, call out with a loud voice: with accusative of thing(s), Actes 19:32; before orat. dir., Marc 10:48, Luc 18:39, al.; (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Marc 5:7, Apocalypse 14:15, al.; λέγων, Matthieu 8:29, al.; of public teaching, Jean 1:15, Romains 9:27, al.; of importunate prayer (cf. Job 35:12, Psaumes 3:5, al.), Romains 8:15, Galates 4:6; pf. with Pres. sense (vernac.; M, Pr., 147), Jean 1:15 
SYN.: see: βοάω

G2897.def:
κραιπάλη
(κρεπάλη, WH), -ης, ἡ (cf. κραιπαλάω for שִׁכּוֹר, Ésaïe 24:20 29:9) 
drunken nausea (EV, surfeiting): Luc 21:34.†
SYN.: κῶμος, revelling; μέθη, drunkeness; οἰνοφλυγία, a debauch; πότος, a drinking bout (see Tr., Syn., § lxi).

G2898.def:
κρανίον, -ου, τό
(κάρα, the head), [in LXX: Juges 9:53, 4Ki.9:35 (גֻּלְגֹּלֶת)* ;] 
a skull: Matthieu 27:33, Marc 15:22, Luc 23:33, Jean 19:17.†

G2899.def:
κράσπεδον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX: Nombres 15:38-39 (צִיצִת) Deutéronome 22:12, Zacharie 8:23 (כָּנָף)* ;] 
__1. in cl., an edge, border. 
__2. In LXX (see supr.) and NT, a tassel or corner: Matthieu 9:20 14:36 23:5, Marc 6:56, Luc 8:44.†
